been quiet because I was building something 🤍 not a new body — a new routine

#comeback #routine #healthylifestyle

slides.text:
I've been ghosting you.

Because I've been
working on something.

Show up.
Even for 20 minutes.

Strength three times a week.
Nothing heroic.

Food that works with me.

Protein first.
Nothing off-limits.

Walks count.
All of them.

10k steps, most days.
No treadmill drama.

Rest is part of the plan.

Sleep is when the work
actually sticks.

slides.heading: That's why there is SOMA.
slides.body: Not another plan off the internet — a tool that builds the routine around your body and your state.
